```json
{
  "dataset_name": "credit_g",
  "model_family": "distance_knn",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "duration_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized loan duration using training set mean and std, enabling scale-normalized distance computation for KNN",
      "value_range": [-1.36, 2.87],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes duration to unit scale so it contributes proportionally to Euclidean distance in KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(duration - 22.01) / 13.237"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_amount_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized credit amount using training set mean and std, enabling scale-normalized distance computation",
      "value_range": [-1.12, 3.84],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes credit amount to unit scale preventing it from dominating KNN distance due to large raw values",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(credit_amount - 3778.04) / 3166.377"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_zscore",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age using training set mean and std",
      "value_range": [-1.37, 2.90],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalizes age for balanced contribution to KNN distance metric",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 35.355) / 11.203"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_duration_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed product of normalized credit amount and duration, capturing joint risk exposure in a compressed scale",
      "value_range": [0.0, 8.5],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures combined exposure of large loans over long periods, improving neighborhood geometry for similar risk profiles",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p((credit_amount / 3778.04) * (duration / 22.01))"
    },
    {
      "name": "installment_burden_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of installment commitment rate to existing credits, measuring per-credit payment burden normalized by training mean",
      "value_range": [0.25, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures relative payment burden per credit line, useful for finding similar financial stress profiles in KNN",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "installment_commitment / np.maximum(existing_credits, 1)"
    },
    {
      "name": "checking_status_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of checking account status from most negative to most positive balance, enabling distance computation on account health",
      "value_range": [0.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts categorical checking status into ordered numeric scale reflecting financial health for KNN distance",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 1, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 2, 3)))"
    },
    {
      "name": "savings_status_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of savings account status from lowest to highest savings level",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts categorical savings status into ordered numeric scale for meaningful KNN distance computation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 1, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 2, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 3, 4))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "employment_ordinal",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ordinal encoding of employment duration from unemployed to longest tenure",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "ordinal_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Converts employment duration categories into ordered numeric scale for KNN distance, capturing job stability gradient",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0, np.where(employment == '<1', 1, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 2, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 3, 4))))"
    },
    {
      "name": "financial_stability_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite score combining normalized checking status, savings status, and employment ordinals into a single financial stability index",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "composite_score",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Single-dimensional prototype distance feature capturing overall financial stability, improving KNN cluster separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.where(checking_status == '<0', 0, np.where(checking_status == '0<=X<200', 1, np.where(checking_status == '>=200', 2, 3))) / 3.0 + np.where(savings_status == '<100', 0, np.where(savings_status == '100<=X<500', 1, np.where(savings_status == '500<=X<1000', 2, np.where(savings_status == '>=1000', 3, 4)))) / 4.0 + np.where(employment == 'unemployed', 0, np.where(employment == '<1', 1, np.where(employment == '1<=X<4', 2, np.where(employment == '4<=X<7', 3, 4)))) / 4.0) / 3.0, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "credit_amount_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed credit amount normalized by training mean log value, reducing skewness for better distance computation",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "scale_normalized",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces right-skew in credit amount distribution, improving KNN distance symmetry for high-value loans",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.log1p(credit_amount) / np.log1p(3778.04)"
    },
    {
      "name": "high_risk_profile_indicator",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of overall risk profile based on combination of checking status, savings level, employment stability, and loan burden. Score 0 indicates very low risk profile (positive checking, high savings, stable employment, low installment), score 1 indicates very high risk profile (negative checking, low savings, unstable employment, high installment commitment). Intermediate values reflect mixed risk signals.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a holistic risk prototype distance anchor for KNN, grouping similar risk profiles together in feature space",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "loan_purpose_risk_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic risk score for loan purpose based on typical repayment patterns and asset backing. Score near 0 indicates lower-risk purposes (used car, real estate, education with asset backing), score near 1 indicates higher-risk purposes (retraining, repairs, other with limited asset backing). Radio/TV and new car fall in middle range.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Encodes domain knowledge about loan purpose risk into a continuous scale for KNN neighborhood similarity on purpose-based risk",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
```
